title: Canada’s Leader, Once a Curiosity at Asia Summits, Is Now a Star
summary_full: Prime Minister Mark Carney is courting Europe, but the bigger payoff might be in China, where he will share summit stages with Xi Jinping, Vladimir Putin and President Trump.
